scripts.dev:pathway: npm run free:pathway-ports && npm run build -w @wob/pathway-core && concurrently -n pathway-core,pathway-server,pathway-web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @wob/pathway-core" "npm run dev -w @wob/pathway-server" "npm run dev -w @wob/pathway-web"
scripts.build:pathway: npm run build -w @wob/pathway-core && npm run build -w @wob/pathway-server && npm run build -w @wob/pathway-web
scripts.typecheck:pathway: npm run typecheck -w @wob/pathway-core && npm run typecheck -w @wob/pathway-server && npm run typecheck -w @wob/pathway-web
